name: Deploy Website
description: Build the tachin.ai marketing website from the git source (sites/tachin-website/), deploy to a Firebase staging channel for review, gate on owner approval, promote to production, and verify. Source of truth is git — NOT Google Drive. Does not touch the /public file service.

site_src.description: Path to site source in repo

steps.title: Assemble the site from git source
steps.description:
Build the deployable site tree from the repo.

```bash
rm -rf ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public && mkdir -p ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public && cp -r ${site_src}/* ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public/ && echo '=== Files ===' && find ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public -type f | sort && echo '=== Count ===' && find ${hosting_dir}/hosting_public -type f | wc -l
```

⚠️ The site source is git (${site_src}). Do NOT download from Drive. Drive is only used by the separate public file service.
⚠️ Run as ONE command chain.
steps.accept_criteria: hosting_public populated from git source. File listing and count reported. index.html present at root.

steps.title: Verify firebase.json hosting config
steps.description:
Confirm ${hosting_dir}/firebase.json has "public": "hosting_public" and preserves the /public/** rewrite to proxy-service (that rewrite belongs to the separate file service and must remain).

```bash
cat ${hosting_dir}/firebase.json
```

steps.title: Deploy to staging channel
steps.description:
```bash
cd ${hosting_dir} && firebase hosting:channel:deploy staging --project=${firebase_project} --expires 7d
```
Extract and report the staging Channel URL.
steps.accept_criteria: Deploy complete. Staging URL extracted and reported.

steps.title: Verify staging completeness
steps.description:
Verify every page and a sample of assets return HTTP 200 on the staging URL.

```bash
STAGING_URL="<staging-url>"
for path in '' 'index.html' 'styles.css' 'about.html' 'security.html' 'privacy.html' 'terms.html' 'newly-released.html'; do
  echo "  /${path}: $(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${STAGING_URL}/${path}")"
done
```
⚠️ Any 404 means an incomplete deploy — return to step 1.
steps.accept_criteria: All pages HTTP 200. Sample assets HTTP 200. No 404s.

steps.title: Owner approval for production
steps.description: Report the staging URL and a summary (pages, asset count) and request approval to promote to production.
steps.approval_message: 🚀 Staging is ready: <staging-url>. Review and reply approve to promote to production, or reject.

steps.title: Promote to production
steps.description:
```bash
cd ${hosting_dir} && firebase deploy --only hosting --project=${firebase_project}
```
Extract and report the production Hosting URL.

steps.title: Verify production
steps.description:
Confirm all pages return HTTP 200 with non-zero size on https://${firebase_project}.web.app, and a sample asset loads.

```bash
for path in '' 'index.html' 'styles.css' 'about.html'; do
  echo "  /${path}: $(curl -sf -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "https://${firebase_project}.web.app/${path}")"
done
```
steps.accept_criteria: All pages HTTP 200 with content. Sample asset HTTP 200. Site live.

pre_flight: Ensure the git workspace is clean and on the main branch before assembling the site.
